sloka: यथा ऽस्तं गत आदित्ये नावतिष्ठन्ति रश्मयः।तथा तस्मिन्निपतिते राक्षसास्ते गता दिशः ।। ६.९१.८४ ।।
transliteration: yathā 'staṁ gata āditye nāvatiṣṭhanti raśmayaḥ।tathā tasminnipatite rākṣasāste gatā diśaḥ ।। 6.91.84 ।।

translations.english: Just as Sun rays go away as soon as the Sun sets in the evening, the Rakshasas also went in all directions seeing Indrajith fallen.
